metadata.title: When Valorant Gave Me 2 Kills and My Brain Said ‘Nope, Not Today’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just stumble into a double kill?
Enemy must’ve hit the snooze button.
Click if your aim’s a hot mess but the killfeed still loves you.
Valorant logic: broken but beautiful.

Tap if you’ve ever lucked into kills you didn’t deserve!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
